title: coupling several rotors -- does the crossover survive?

M1.statement: matvec Lanczos ground-state energy matches dense ED; ground state in the trivial Gauss sector (<A_s> = 1) -- coupled Z_3 gauge ED correct

M2.statement: crossover SURVIVES coupling: <B_p>(lambda) runs 0->1 for P=1,2,3; identical across P at strong coupling (plaquettes decouple); strong <B_p> ~ lambda (log law)

M3.statement: area-law factorisation: <W_P> = C_P <B_p>^P at strong coupling (F70 independent-plaquette product, C_P = O(1)); ratio -> 1 toward deconfinement

M4.statement: sigma = -ln<B_p> positive with strong-coupling log slope d sigma/d ln(lambda) ~ -1 for every P -- confinement survives coupling

M5.statement: weak-coupling order increases with P (more coupled rotors = more ordered) -- the finite-size precursor of the deconfinement transition; coupling organises the crossover into a transition
